title: Is there a cheaper Claude provider?
author: Pristine-Seat-9849
selftext: A friend of mine recently put me onto Routermint to get access to Claude. You basically buy credits from them and it ends up being way cheaper than paying for the official Anthropic monthly subscription. It gets the job done perfectly for my coding tasks and the credit system makes it super affordable since you only pay for what you use. But before I completely commit and load up a massive balance on there, I just wanted to ask around and see if there is an even better option. Are there any other cheap providers or alternatives you guys are using right now to run Claude without breaking the bank? Let me know what you recommend.

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
